the use of sex-selected semen in TAI protocols for heifers is acceptable and that the use of conventional or sex-selected semen in ED heifers resulted in similar pregnancy rates.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
heifers subjected to a TAI protocol with sex-selected semen after the use of a modified 4-day Co-synch + PRID protocol had an overall P/AI of 64% and a pregnancy loss rate of 11.5%.

heifers can be subjected to TAI protocols with sex-selected semen with good results.
heifers inseminated using TAI with sex selected semen can have P/AI comparable to those of conventional semen.
